official_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for eligible students pursuing regular undergraduate, postgraduate and specified professional higher education.
objectives: Support meritorious students from low-income families in higher education.
ministry: Ministry of Education, Department of Higher Education
department: Department of Higher Education
implementing_agency: Department of Higher Education; applications and disbursement through NSP/PFMS processes
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for the first three undergraduate years; ₹20,000 per annum for postgraduate study and specified fourth/fifth-year technical study, subject to course-specific rules.
benefit_amount: ₹12,000/year (first three UG years); ₹20,000/year (PG and specified professional-course years)
coverage: 82,000 fresh scholarships per year in the 2025-26 FAQ framework; allocations by board, stream, gender and category.
duration: Year-to-year renewal up to a total period not exceeding five years, subject to course and renewal conditions.
beneficiary_groups: Class XII pass-outs above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream/board, enrolled in the first year of a regular eligible degree course.
gender_eligibility: All genders; allocation includes gender parity.
income_limit: Annual family income up to ₹4.5 lakh (2025-26 FAQ)
residency_requirement: Indian national studying in India
education_criteria: Class XII board merit threshold and regular college/university enrollment; renewal requires prescribed academic progress and attendance.
other_eligibility_conditions: Must not receive another scholarship or fee reimbursement.
Regular course only; correspondence/distance courses are not eligible.
Fresh applicants must be in the board top-20th percentile list and admitted to first-year regular graduation.
Renewal requires at least 50% marks and 75% attendance, as stated in the 2025-26 FAQ.
exclusions: Diploma students.
Applicants who took a drop after Class XII (as stated in the 2025-26 FAQ).
Concurrent recipient of another scholarship/fee reimbursement.
mandatory_documents: Aadhaar or Aadhaar Enrollment ID for One-Time Registration; Aadhaar linked to bank account required for final disbursal
document_notes: Current-year FAQ differentiates fresh and renewal documents. Do not require category or disability certificates from applicants who do not claim those provisions.
application_mode: Online
application_steps: Create One-Time Registration (OTR) using an active mobile number and Aadhaar/Aadhaar Enrollment ID.
Log in to NSP, select domicile state and Post-Matric to generate Application ID.
Select PM-USP CSSS, enter general/category/academic details and upload required documents.
Submit before the application-year deadline and complete institute and State Nodal Officer verification.
registration_process: NSP student registration followed by application and institute verification.
application_period: The cited FAQ is for 2025-26 and states the portal became live 2025-06-02; that date is historical. No 2026-27 application window was established.
renewal_process: Apply for renewal through NSP subject to marks, attendance and course progression rules.
selection_process: Merit list among eligible applicants using board percentile and allocation rules; 2025-26 FAQ describes allocation by gender, stream and category.
terms_and_conditions: Award subject to course eligibility, annual allocation, academic performance and verification.
how_to_check_status: NSP Student Login → My Application → Check Your Status; payment status can also be checked through PFMS Know Your Payment.
source_authorities: Department of Higher Education / myScheme, Government of India
Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India

Ministry annual report says continuation approved in 2022 ran until 2026-03-31 or further review; no 2026-27 continuation order was established. Do not represent the 2025-26 cycle as open or assume continuation unchanged.

description: A special digital education-loan product for students admitted on merit to notified Quality Higher Education Institutions (QHEIs), with a separate interest-subvention pathway for eligible applicants.
objectives: Enable collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans at notified quality HEIs and provide limited interest subvention for eligible borrowers.
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
implementing_agency: Participating scheduled banks, RRBs and cooperative banks; Department of Higher Education administers portal/subvention
benefits: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loan based on course/institution costs; no uniform loan ceiling. Government credit guarantee of 75% on loans up to ₹7.5 lakh. Eligible students with family income up to ₹8 lakh can receive 3% interest subvention on loan principal up to ₹10 lakh during moratorium, subject to annual cap/selection.

The portal currently lists an FY 2025-26 interest-subvention claim window from 1 September through 31 December 2026 for eligible claims; the loan financing bank submits the claim after the student opts in.
coverage: Degree/diploma programmes at Quality HEIs in India identified under current list; loan product and interest benefit have distinct eligibility.
duration: Repayment period up to 15 years excluding moratorium (course period plus one year), as per guidelines. Interest subvention during moratorium and subject to successful course completion.
beneficiary_groups: Students admitted on merit to notified Quality Higher Education Institutions in India.
Separate interest-subvention eligibility includes family income up to ₹8 lakh, subject to selection and no disqualifying duplicate benefits.
education_criteria: Degree/diploma admission at a QHEI; management quota excluded.
other_eligibility_conditions: Education loan available to students of any family income.
3% subvention has family-income cap ₹8 lakh and applies to loans up to ₹10 lakh; limited to 1 lakh awards per year and selection rules.
exclusions: Management quota or similar admission does not qualify.

Other government scholarship/interest-subvention/fee-reimbursement may disqualify scheme benefit; course discontinuation/expulsion generally disqualifies interest subvention and credit guarantee except documented medical discontinuation.
mandatory_documents: Class XII / last qualifying examination / diploma marksheet
Income proof issued by public authority or college authority
conditional_documents: Co-obligant/guarantor photograph if collateral security is given.
document_notes: This list reflects the current portal FAQ upload list; banks may request additional KYC/due-diligence records. Portal formats: PDF/JPEG as stated in FAQ.
application_mode: Online through PM-Vidyalaxmi portal and participating lender
application_steps: Register on PM-Vidyalaxmi portal using mobile number and email.
Complete the common education-loan application, upload documents and select up to three banks.
Review and submit; bank performs due diligence and sanctions/disburses independently.
For interest subvention, opt in on the portal; for eligible FY 2025-26 claims, ensure financing bank submits during 1 Sep–31 Dec 2026 claim window.
registration_process: Sign up with mobile number and email, then use student login for the common education-loan application. Aadhaar is mandatory per portal FAQ.
application_period: For FY 2025–26 interest-subvention claims, the portal notice displayed a bank claim-submission window from 01-09-2026 to 31-12-2026. This is a financing-bank claim window for eligible opted-in applicants, not a general education-loan application opening.
renewal_process: Loan repayment follows lender agreement; interest subvention only during moratorium and once for UG/PG/integrated course.
selection_process: Loan sanction is by the selected bank after due diligence. For 3% subvention, up to 1 lakh applicants/year; stated preference sequence prioritizes government HEI admission, technical/professional course, government-school board history, rural school, then female students if the cap is exceeded.
how_to_check_status: Use Track Loan Application in student login for submitted, in-process, sanctioned, rejected and other statuses; portal FAQ directs rejected loan applicants to the bank for reasons.
research_notes: Ministry 2024 guidelines are used for loan/subvention benefit rules. Current official portal FAQ (checked 2026-10-31) supplies documents, Aadhaar, process, status and current FY 2025-26 claim window. The FAQ broad summary mentions full subvention at income <=₹4.5 lakh; the Ministry guideline assigns full subvention under separate PM-USP CSIS only to specified approved technical/professional courses. This record follows the detailed guideline and does not claim universal full-subvention under PM-Vidyalaxmi. The claim deadline is not a loan-application deadline.

description: Free monthly foodgrain entitlement for households already identified as Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH) under NFSA, through the Public Distribution System.
objectives: Provide food and nutrition security through free NFSA foodgrain entitlements.
department: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
implementing_agency: Government of Madhya Pradesh Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection Department; Fair Price Shops under PDS
benefits: AAY: 35 kg foodgrains per household per month. PHH: 5 kg foodgrains per person per month, free of cost under continuation from 1 January 2024 for five years.
coverage: NFSA-identified AAY households and PHH beneficiaries; not a separate open-enrollment cash scheme.
duration: Free foodgrain continuation stated for 1 Jan 2024 through 31 Dec 2028.
beneficiary_groups: Existing NFSA AAY households and Priority Household beneficiaries.
other_eligibility_conditions: Entitlement depends on existing NFSA status/category and recorded household/person count.
document_notes: No universal separate document list for PMGKAY; new NFSA inclusion/document checklist is state-specific and not asserted here.
application_mode: Offline through Fair Price Shop/PDS; entitlement portability through One Nation One Ration Card where enabled
application_steps: Check NFSA/ration-card status with MP Food/Civil Supplies or local Fair Price Shop.
Eligible existing AAY/PHH household collects its monthly entitlement from an FPS; portability is available under ONORC.
registration_process: DFPD describes PMGKAY foodgrain distribution through NFSA/TPDS to existing AAY and PHH beneficiaries. States identify eligible households and administer ration-card data and fair-price-shop distribution; a separate PMGKAY application form is not described in the reviewed source.
application_period: Free grain distribution period stated 2024-01-01 through 2028-12-31.
renewal_process: No separate renewal; NFSA ration-card status and category are administered under state procedures.
selection_process: Beneficiary is identified through NFSA categories; monthly allocation and delivery through State PDS/FPS.
research_notes: This record describes free foodgrains under the current PMGKAY policy period and existing NFSA entitlement. It does not imply new automatic eligibility or a separate application. MP-specific ration-card inclusion, quantities of commodity mix, and grievance workflow require MP department source review.
